observation: The reference was extended with 524K/1M samples after the original suite run. Its outer duration and original timestamps were retained. Use recorded per-size samples and their intervals, not the old outer duration, for performance comparison.
action: Published reference files remain unchanged; annotate this discrepancy in candidate evidence.
long_prompt_limit: The comparison warns about actual token-count differences at the two extended sizes. Token rates normalize by each request count, but the larger-size workloads are not identical prompts. Do not treat these as strict identical-workload speedups.
prompt_difference_source: servebench/prefill.py seeds each document as 1000 * repeat + size index. The native extension ran only [524288, 1000000], giving size indices 0/1; the full release-tp3 suite gives these sizes indices 3/4. It therefore selects different deterministic documents even with the same client and tokenizer.
